jobs.description: This site uses cookies to measure visits and our advertising. Details are in our Privacy Policy. Accept Indoor GPS. Finally Real. Oriient delivers precise, real-time indoor location as a software-only layer, making physical spaces measurable and actionable. 3-foot accuracy that holds up in live environments at scale No beacons, no WiFi dependency, and no infrastructure rollout Deploys like software, not hardware Already operating across thousands of locations globally Oriient makes the inside of buildings measurable, so people, assets, and systems can operate with the clarity they expect outdoors. How Oriient Makes Indoor GPS Work Oriient uses the natural magnetic signature inside each building, combined with sensors already built into smartphones, to understand precise location indoors. Every indoor space has its own magnetic pattern. Oriient maps that pattern once, then uses advanced algorithms to match live smartphone sensor readings against it, creating accurate indoor positioning without beacons, WiFi dependency, or dedicated hardware. The result is a software-only location layer that works inside real buildings, at enterprise scale. No hardware. No guesswork. Fast to Deploy. Easy to Scale. Built for Real Buildings. Oriient makes indoor location practical to launch and expand. A building is mapped once, uploaded to Oriient's cloud, and activated through existing apps, devices, workflows, and systems. No beacons. No WiFi dependency. No infrastructure rollout. 1. Map the environment - A trained mapper walks the space with a standard smartphone to capture the building's magnetic landscape. 2. Build the location layer - Oriient creates a precise indoor location map and securely uploads it to the cloud. 3. Integrate into existing apps - Oriient connects through a lightweight SDK, demo app, white-label app, or customer application. 4. Match live movement to the map - Proprietary algorithms compare smartphone sensor signals to the map to determine precise indoor position. 5. Activate indoor guidance and workflows - People, assets, and systems can begin using real-time indoor location across navigation, picking, operations, and other workflows. 6. Manage and extend the experience - Teams can update content, locations, notifications, and integrations through dashboards and APIs. BRING REAL-TIME INTELLIGENCE TO YOUR ENVIRONMENT. jobs.title: Senior Product Manager & AI Builder
jobs.description: Oriient ALL JOBS Senior Product Manager & AI Builder Product Management Tel Aviv Senior Full-time Description Senior Product Manager & AI Builder Product manager and hands-on builder, driving Oriient’s AI products and its move to agentic R&D Location: Tel Aviv (hybrid) Type: Full-time About Oriient At Oriient, we are building the world’s most accurate Indoor GPS, and the only one that needs no hardware at all. We are a VC-backed company in a phase of hyper-growth with strong market traction, live in thousands of locations worldwide across retail, smart buildings, hospitals, campuses, and other large indoor environments. On top of the positioning engine sits a thick agentic layer that turns location into intelligence. Every session feeds a dataset of indoor traffic and behavior at enormous volume, unmatched anywhere in the market, and a growing set of AI agents and LLM-based tools that surface insights from it: how people move, dwell, and shop inside physical spaces, delivered to our customers and to our own teams as answers, alerts, and recommendations rather than raw data. We are also rebuilding how we build. Oriient is turning its product and R&D workflow into an agentic, AI-native process, from discovery and design through code, test, release, and production monitoring. Internally, the same shift is already underway across ops, sales, HR, and analytics, where agents and internal tools are replacing manual work. Job Summary We are looking for a Senior Product Manager who is also a hands-on builder. Not a PM who only writes specs for someone else to implement, and not an engineer without product judgment. Someone who can find the problem, decide it is worth solving, build the first working version themselves, and then take it to real users. You will take AI products and internal agents from problem to production, across the company. That means customer-facing AI capabilities built on our indoor data, and the internal agents and tools our own teams run on. The scope is deliberately broad: the problems worth solving will not always sit in the same department, and we are looking for someone who can pick up any of them without needing the domain handed to them. In parallel, you will join an effort already underway to turn Oriient’s R&D into an agentic process, and build a meaningful part of it yourself. The goal is an order-of-magnitude change in how fast we move from an idea to production. You will be part of our product team and work closely with R&D, Ops, and every team whose workflow you are about to change. Key Responsibilities Own AI products end to end Own your part of the roadmap. Help define the product roadmap, decide what gets built in your area, in what order, and why, and make sure every effort ties back to a measurable outcome for a real user, whether that user is a customer or a colleague. Run your own discovery. Sit with the people whose work you are changing, find the friction yourself, and turn it into a prioritized set of problems rather than a queue of requests. Define what good means for AI products. Together with the engineers building them, set evaluation criteria, quality thresholds, and release gates for AI-based features, and keep watching them after launch. Know when to stop. Set go/no-go gates on exploratory work and make the call, with the team, to kill the efforts that do not pay off, early. Build it yourself Ship working software. Use current models and agentic coding tools to build and ship agents, tools, and prototypes, sometimes on your own and sometimes alongside engineering. You are a builder, not only a spec writer. jobs.title: Algorithm Engineer
jobs.description: Oriient ALL JOBS Algorithm Engineer Engineering Tel Aviv Senior Description About Oriient At Oriient, we are building the world’s most advanced and scalable Indoor GPS technology. We are a VC-backed company in a phase of hyper-growth with substantial market traction. Our platform powers indoor location experiences across retail, smart buildings, hospitals and healthcare centers, campuses, and emerging verticals. Oriient’s hardware-free, plug & play solution enables fast and cost-effective deployments at scale, unlocking new capabilities based on high-accuracy positioning, AI, and large-scale data processing. Job Summary As an algorithm engineer you will be part of Oriient’s algorithm team and be responsible for the core localization and navigation components. You will report to the Algorithm team leader and work with other team members and the entire RnD group. You will play a key role in a small team of top notch algorithm engineers, maturing the world's most advanced IndoorGPS platform with highly advanced algorithms. Key Responsibilities Develop classical and ML algorithms modules Gain deep understanding of existing core algorithmic modules, including their theoretical foundations, assumptions, and limitations, and adapt or extend them as needed. Design, develop, and implement new algorithms to address product and research challenges. Own the full algorithm development cycle from research and prototyping through implementation, validation, and production delivery. Investigate customers issues and anomalies Develop needed pipeline and infrastructure for evaluation and development of new and current features Requirements B.Sc in Electrical Engineering - Must GPA > 85 from a prominent university At least 3 years of hands-on, real-world experience with algorithm design and development in one or more of the following fields: Machine learning/Deep learning Kalman/particle filters and similar methods Digital signal processing Strong analytical and mathematical skills, including being able to: Understand and Implement algorithms from academic papers Come up with and Implement simulations and analysis tools for complex algorithms Handle large amounts of data Passion to use algorithms and science to build a system that solves difficult problems Hands-on experience designing, validating, testing and implementing complex algorithms Excellent MATLAB & Python proficiency. Not Required, but a Big Advantage: M.Sc. A rich software background Cloud platform experience What We Offer A high-impact role at the core of a rapidly growing technology company. Dynamic, collaborative team environment with strong ownership culture. Competitive salary and benefits. Flexible working hours and remote-work options. ALL JOBS
